free_tier.stated: The cheapest plan the vendor's pages let you order is Gigabit VPS 1 at USD 21 a year: 1 fair-share core, 1 GB RAM, 10 GB SSD, 1 IPv4 plus IPv6, 1 TB of bandwidth, in Los Angeles, Salt Lake City, Portland, New York, Miami and Dallas. The Premium Ryzen page prices RYZEN 512 MB at USD 24 a year with 1 fair-share core at 3.5 GHz+, 512 MB RAM, 10 GB NVMe, 1 IPv4 plus a /64 IPv6 and 500 GB at 1 Gbit, which is the same shape the tracker lists at USD 17.99 a year. The Special Ryzen Promo store page shows every tier 'Out of Stock', including Ryzen SP1 at USD 3.00 a month.
